notes: Shipping: a Ship page. The orders waiting to ship in one list, then a step-by-step flow with the order's cards in view: address, package (size and weight right there, presets as quick picks), rates cheapest first with insurance, buy. The bought label shows in the app and one Print label button sends it straight to the label printer you pick once in Settings, at 4x6, no print window. The recipient name box searches your customers as you type and fills every field, and everyone you ship to is remembered with their address. Tracking updates on its own from EasyPost, with Copy on every tracking number. Live Desk: bags collapse to one line so a full bag never hides the others. Every bag shows Original, Final and the percent off, with a slider and a total tied together; Save cuts every card so the books carry what each sold for. Email offer and Copy offer on a bag. A card sitting in someone's bag or a sellout is marked on the lot editor, Live Desk's dock, Stream Mode's dock and the trade screen, the same as Inventory. Sellout from Inventory: a stack for one buyer from lots, bulk picks or chip scans, percent or dollars off, email or copy the offer, mark it sold. Orders: a full order editor (items, prices, shipping, a discount, the customer, notes) and nothing locks you out of an order any more: hold or release any order, edit or delete on any state, undo shipped, undo cancel. A title on a buyout. A Movers tab on Benchmark Pricing. Pricing: a Price this card from eBay switch on the card panel. A Benchmark within a dollar under the cheapest listing rounds up, and a group of one sale never beats the group holding most of the sales. Bulk cards in buyouts show exact cents. Refresh pricing on the buyout card panel. Your ignored and pasted eBay sales now reach the cloud's number, and a stamped card gets its own eBay bucket. Vintage Unlimited NM cards get a cloud price. Buyout and sellout offer texts show market then the offer for every card. Stream night: the app's helpers log to disk and restart themselves when they die, the tap watcher runs in the background, the window always opens on screen, a health strip on Stream Mode, and a one-button pre-show check. Live art picks the clip for the card's printing on Live Desk and the show display. Inventory: one click links the 238 cards that have a TCGplayer link but no product id. The card editor's Image URL field updates the shared catalog. Behind the scenes: the app shows as Benchmark TCG in Task Manager. Four database self-checks fixed. JustTCG and PkmnPrices are out of the code. A diff tool finds a new set's ids.
